recomputation: none. No reconstruction, operator, gate or table is recomputed by this amendment
scientific_disposition: R0C accepted at the artifact commit below

three_commits.execution_commit_meaning: where the code was when the run started, captured by the start-of-run attestation before anything was written
three_commits.manifest_build_commit_meaning: HEAD when the manifest object was built, which for an 804 s run is after it. In R0C this was a commit made while the run was still going, so it never described the executing code
three_commits.artifact_commit_meaning: the tree the outputs were committed in

deprecated_field.name: git_commit
deprecated_field.replacement: execution_commit, inherited from the start-of-run attestation; manifest_build_commit keeps the old value under a name that says what it is

why_the_numbers_stand.rule: the execution attestation is the stronger record and it is clean

also_corrected: the R0C report labelled the manifest build commit as the execution commit; it now reports all three separately
the R0C report gate table showed most R0A gates ABSENT because it read only the R0C run manifest; it now joins the canonical R0A gate artifact with the R0C-specific gates G11, G14 and G15
